# Results (generated by analysis/summarize.py)

Main comparison: bottleneck 10 Mbit/s, 2 bulk TCP streams, congested phase unless noted. Values are mean ± 95% CI over runs (n = baseline 5, static 5, adaptive 5).

| Metric | Baseline | SDN-QoS static | SDN-QoS adaptive |
|---|---|---|---|
| VoIP delay, idle phase (ms) | 5.85 ± 0.23 | 6.2 ± 0.28 | 5.73 ± 0.16 |
| VoIP mean delay (ms) | 879 ± 23 | 5.71 ± 0.18 | 5.7 ± 0.23 |
| VoIP p95 delay (ms) | 1.67e+03 ± 52 | 7.45 ± 1.3 | 7.24 ± 0.94 |
| VoIP p99 delay (ms) | 1.7e+03 ± 56 | 11 ± 1.4 | 12.3 ± 5.9 |
| VoIP jitter RFC3550 (ms) | 6.26 ± 6 | 0.427 ± 0.28 | 0.962 ± 1.4 |
| VoIP loss (%) | 4.14 ± 0.14 | 0 ± 0 | 0 ± 0 |
| Video mean delay (ms) | 885 ± 23 | 5.82 ± 0.26 | 5.95 ± 0.85 |
| Video p95 delay (ms) | 1.67e+03 ± 53 | 7.98 ± 1.3 | 8.41 ± 2.8 |
| Video jitter (ms) | 1.44 ± 0.4 | 0.418 ± 0.23 | 0.765 ± 1.1 |
| Video loss (%) | 3.3 ± 0.53 | 0 ± 0 | 0.016 ± 0.044 |
| Video goodput (kbit/s) | 2.96e+03 ± 16 | 3.07e+03 ± 0 | 3.06e+03 ± 1.4 |
| Bulk throughput, congested (kbit/s) | 6.13e+03 ± 2.5e+02 | 4.66e+03 ± 61 | 4.62e+03 ± 46 |
| Bulk throughput, recovery (kbit/s) | 8.75e+03 ± 1.8e+02 | 4.65e+03 ± 82 | 8.21e+03 ± 3e+02 |
| Jain fairness, bulk streams | 1 ± 5.1e-06 | 1 ± 2.9e-06 | 1 ± 1.5e-16 |
| Bottleneck utilisation, congested | 0.881 ± 0.025 | 0.758 ± 0.0036 | 0.753 ± 0.0036 |
| PacketIn messages per run | 153 ± 1.5 | 213 ± 5.4 | 214 ± 3.5 |
| Flow setups (classified) per run | 0 ± 0 | 68.4 ± 4.3 | 68.4 ± 3 |
| Controller flow-setup time (us) | n/a | 438 ± 67 | 411 ± 79 |
| Adaptation events per run | 0 ± 0 | 0 ± 0 | 3 ± 0 |
